Bug_Title: Math operands should be cast before assignment
Bug_Explanation: The code contains several instances where integer operations are performed and the results are assigned to larger data types without casting the operands. This leads to loss of precision or overflow issues.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases trigger the bug by calling methods from the MathOperandBug class that perform integer arithmetic without casting the operands to the appropriate types before the operation. This results in unexpected values due to integer overflow and loss of precision.
